prompt:
A clean line-art blocking diagram of one scene of a live-action short drama, vertical composition: the place of Image 1 drawn in simple black outlines on white, with the segment's people in their places at its start, the way a master shot shows the whole scene before it is cut into shots. Keep Image 1's camera position, framing, walls, windows, doorways and furniture, traced in outline; only add the people.
Image 1: the location INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, the front view, with no people
Image 2: the character sheet of Lin Qingyu (21), look S1
Image 3: the character sheet of Ji Ran (27), look S2
Image 4: the character sheet of Xu Banxia (24)
Image 5: the location INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people: use it only for where the place's walls, doors, windows and furniture stand; draw the place as the front view shows it
Image 6: the location INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people: use it only for where the place's walls, doors, windows and furniture stand; draw the place as the front view shows it
Image 7: the location INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people: use it only for where the place's walls, doors, windows and furniture stand; draw the place as the front view shows it
Image 8: the location INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people: use it only for where the place's walls, doors, windows and furniture stand; draw the place as the front view shows it
Draw each person as a clean outline figure that can be told apart by hairstyle, build and the shape of their outfit, from their character sheet; no faces in detail. Do not copy a sheet's layout, white background or multiple views. Each person appears once, whole and at natural scale for the place, on the furniture and floor of Image 1, facing the way the start says.
Only three people appear: Lin Qingyu, Ji Ran, and Xu Banxia. Nobody else is there.
At the start: Camera on the front-wall side, by the pin-up wall, facing the walnut desk and the walnut door on the right wall; the camera stays on this side throughout. Lin Qingyu stands at the open walnut door on the right wall, just inside it on the pale oak floor, soaked, breathless, hair dripping, facing into the room. Ji Ran stands on the open oak floor a step from the walnut door, facing Lin Qingyu. Xu Banxia stands at the door-side corner of the walnut desk, facing them. There is one walnut desk in front of the floor-to-ceiling windows, one high-backed black leather chair behind it and one walnut door.

No shading, solid black areas, colour or photographic rendering: dark hair and clothes are outlines left white inside; no text, letters, numbers, arrows, labels or watermark.
